content.title: Robinhood CEO's math-focused AI startup Harmonic valued at $1.45 billion in latest fundraising
content.summary: (Reuters) -Harmonic, an artificial intelligence startup co-founded by Robinhood CEO Vlad Tenev, has raised $120 million in new funding, valuing the company at ​$1.45 billion, as it tackles AI "hallucinations" — or incorrect or ‌nonsensical answers — by improving the ability to reason.  The Series C round for the pre-revenue startup was led by Ribbit Capital, ‌with participation from existing investors Sequoia and Kleiner Perkins.
